protocol.name: meter-first full-store rho, 1024 workers declared, depth 6, store priced as shipped
protocol.abort: br OR guard (the census predicate, unchanged from the counter that increments on either)
protocol.detection: per-worker trail comparison; the record store is NOT load-bearing for success

census_fidelity.dict: shipped dict28.o (evicting), twelve-word nodes, 128-bit slot-keyed, 4-probe chains
census_fidelity.why: trail >= guard ring (6) is required for guard stationarity; only the partition series at fixed S carries the W-dependence

store_spec_to_code.shipped_structure: dict28.c: ws_node chains in a bucket array of `u64 nb` pointers; bucket index ws_bucket() returns u64; chain capped at PROBES=4 with FIFO eviction of the tail; capacity = 4*nb by construction
deleted_rows: store_init_route_a (2^128-entry directory, 2^135.75 B footprint, 1.490e39 Ir init) -- not implemented by dict28.c, DELETED not restated

measured_retention.delta_explanation: the Poisson terminal-size limit counts only buckets whose FINAL size is >=5; the shipped store also evicts during fill, so the measured loss exceeds 1-P(size>=5). The sign and size of the delta are what the transient predicts; both are reported, neither is charged.

store_spec_to_code.note: the v33 0.998435 figure is withdrawn as a STORE-retention number: it was the arm's success-resample fraction 1276/1278, a different quantity

trap.event: br OR guard -- exactly the predicate on which the census stall counter increments

derivation.p_br_bound: p_s^32 over the K_STALL=32 squaring window
derivation.role: derivation primary; the measured union rate is corroboration BELOW it, not its source

guard_closed_orbit.note: squaring-only-on-guard is this sub-event, priced separately, not a description of the whole abort

br_only.note: br steps multiply; a br abort abandons the trail and is charged a trail restart inside trap_at_S, no 32-squaring window

trap.no_float: trap_at_S and charge_ir are Python ints; 48 Ir/squaring is the tree's block cost

claim.rule: minimal n with 20000*2^(n/10000) >= W; exact integer test

prices.source: evidence/exec31.json (gcov executed counts on the shipped scripts/ir28/dict28.c) + evidence/sort32.json (executed count of the full-width pre-key path)

state_key_full_width.basis: MAX over 20000 executed calls of the full-width path (canonical extraction of twelve 381-bit residues + min/argmin + insertion sort over twelve full-width values + 48-word lane packing); verdict b30ddc21 flaw 3

static_span_vs_executed_vs_charged.static_span: not defined for a data-dependent loop; the structural maximum is 77 comparisons (n(n-1)/2 + n-1 over twelve)
static_span_vs_executed_vs_charged.charged: 1458 Ir at the executed maximum, which is the structural worst case evaluated at the measured maximum

prices.wide_symbol_charge_rule: charge = static span + sum(loop structural max x body span) for every loop in the disassembly. That sum bounds EVERY single call, so it bounds the maximum over calls a fortiori; v31's aggregate-divided-by-calls figure is retained only as a labelled mean.

derived_rows.basis: two 255-bit modular products (A += linv[kap]*a, D += linv[kap]*b) at 64 Ir each plus a 12-lane load at 4 Ir; verdict b30ddc21: the v31 48-Ir row was not an implementation bound for those products. Guard row unchanged.

bounds_table.bound_formula: <= min(arrivals, capacity) = S, same index set as records[]
<= PROBES = 4 (chain full triggers the shipped eviction)

type_table.code_type: unsigned __int128 (production store); the shipped fixture store uses uint64
